THE JOIN: a stratum multiplies (kappa-2) by an explicit factor F, and because eps is a SQUARE CLASS, F acts through ITS OWN square class -- so a perfect-square factor leaves eps untouched even though kappa moves. Stratum 1 (Aut/metallic) has kappa' = kappa, F = 1, class PRESERVED. Stratum 2 (A->A^2, B->B^2, det 4) has kappa'-2 = (kappa-2)x^2y^2, F = (xy)^2 a PERFECT SQUARE, class PRESERVED -- the kappa-law is non-trivial yet the class passes through untouched, and B497 records that this stratum is transfer-matrix decimation at matrix level, not metaphor. THE DYNAMICS WAS NEVER MISSING; IT WAS UNREACHABLE.
